descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S07 Tap Generate, then leave for another patient, reload or close the tab: on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, and nothing lands on the other patient

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Generation runs on the server: the physician can tap Generate and move to another patient; the Post-Round tab shows a 'generating' state, and on return the note is there or an explicit failure shows, … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.5; TFA-92592 AC 15) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U10 Generate AI Note moves the physician to Post-Round with the generated note there. (UAT TC-14; TFA-92592 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T8 If both models fail, a clear error shows and the dictation is not lost (Empty & Failure States: 'Note not generated' shown, dictation kept; … (TFA-94422 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT OAT-03)
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh physician; two patients per mode with no note and no tasks ({hospitalPatient}, {hospitalPatient2}, {snfResident}, {snfResident2}). Each cell's dictation carries its own blood pressure, so a checkpoint can tell this cell's note from an earlier one

When Cell A (Hospital, leave): on {hospitalPatient} type the cell-A text, press Generate Note & Finish, at once open {hospitalPatient2}; stay 45 s; check its Post-Round and Encounter tabs; return, open Post-Round at once and again after 30 s, then the Encounter tab. …

Then On every return Post-Round shows this cell's note (its blood pressure) or an explicit failure, never only 'Complete the Encounter tab first'; right after returning it shows the note, a generating state or the failure; the dictation is still on the Encounter tab, also after the reload and after the tab was closed; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs per checkpoint below. A note checkpoint passes on this cell's blood pressure ('131/77' or '131 over 77', and so on) or an accepted failure string ('Note not generated', 'couldn’t be generated', 'could not be generated'; exact wording Q18), never on 'Generated clinical note' alone, which an earlier note also shows. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on dev; Source: dev.
